The .geojson files in this folder are data of openAIP, https://www.openaip.net,
recorded on 2026-11-19 from https://storage.openaip.net/openaip-system-exports/
and licensed under the Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 4.0
International License, https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc/4.0/.
They are not covered by the licence of the code around them.

de_asp.geojson and at_asp.geojson are the airspace exports for Germany and
Austria, cut down to the features that reach into the northern Alps around
Munich, Innsbruck and Salzburg and have no more than 250 (Germany) or 110
(Austria) corners. Each feature kept is as openAIP published it, with one
exception: the fields "createdBy" and "updatedBy", which hold the user
identifiers of openAIP's contributors, are removed. The adapter does not
read them, and this repository holds no personal data.

To record them again: fetch de_asp.geojson and at_asp.geojson from the
address above and keep the features whose bounding box touches
47.2..48.5 N, 10.9..13.2 E (Germany) or 47.0..47.95 N, 10.9..13.2 E
(Austria), within the corner limits, in the order of the file. Then run the
tests with VENTI_UPDATE_GOLDEN=1 and review what changed.

at_asp_damaged.geojson is not openAIP's data as published: it is eight
features of at_asp.geojson, seven of them deliberately broken, to test how
the adapter reports what it cannot read. The test that uses it says how
each is broken.

openAIP's data is not certified and must not be used for navigation.
